# FOLFOX patients from Table S7
# Row indices are 1-based in the preview
folfox_data = [
    ("P3", 30.83, "PD"),      # Row 3
    ("P4", 1.041, "SD/PR"),   # Row 4
    ("P5", 1.268, "SD/PR"),   # Row 5
    ("P6", 7.465, "PD"),      # Row 6
    ("P9", 12.59, "PD"),      # Row 9
    ("P11", 3.605, "SD/PR"),  # Row 11
    ("P12", 2.441, "SD/PR"),  # Row 12
    ("P13", 0.4895, "SD/PR"), # Row 13
    ("P14", 2.32, "SD/PR"),   # Row 14
    ("P18", 2.254, "PD"),     # Row 18
    ("P19", 15.4, "PD"),      # Row 19
    ("P23", 6.247, "SD/PR"),  # Row 22
    ("P25", 7.895, "SD/PR"),  # Row 24
]

print(f"Number of FOLFOX patients: {len(folfox_data)}")

# Map to scores and truths
# Score = -IC50 (higher score = more sensitive)
# Truth: SD/PR = 1, PD = 0
scores = []
truths = []
for patient, ic50, response in folfox_data:
    truth = 1 if response == "SD/PR" else 0
    score = -ic50
    scores.append(score)
    truths.append(truth)
    print(f"{patient}: IC50={ic50}, Score={score}, Truth={truth}")

n_pos = sum(truths)
n_neg = len(truths) - n_pos
print(f"\nPositives (SD/PR): {n_pos}")
print(f"Negatives (PD): {n_neg}")

# Calculate AUC using Mann-Whitney U statistic
concordant = 0
tied = 0
for i in range(len(scores)):
    for j in range(len(scores)):
        if truths[i] == 1 and truths[j] == 0:
            if scores[i] > scores[j]:
                concordant += 1
            elif scores[i] == scores[j]:
                tied += 1

auc = (concordant + 0.5 * tied) / (n_pos * n_neg)
print(f"\nConcordant pairs: {concordant}")
print(f"Tied pairs: {tied}")
print(f"AUC = ({concordant} + 0.5*{tied}) / ({n_pos}*{n_neg}) = {auc}")
print(f"Rounded AUC: {round(auc, 3)}")
